description: This file contains utility functions for constructing selectors used in locating elements within a web automation or testing framework, specifically for accessibility roles and attributes.

classes.name: ByRoleOptions
classes.description: Type defining optional parameters for role-based selector functions, including accessibility states and attributes.

methods.name: getByAttributeTextSelector
methods.description: Constructs a selector string for an attribute with specified text or RegExp, escaping the text appropriately.

methods.name: getByTestIdSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string targeting elements with a specific test ID attribute.

methods.name: getByLabelSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for elements with a label matching the provided text or RegExp.

methods.name: getByAltTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for elements with an alt attribute matching the provided text or RegExp.

methods.name: getByTitleSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for elements with a title attribute matching the provided text or RegExp.

methods.name: getByPlaceholderSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for elements with a placeholder attribute matching the provided text or RegExp.

methods.name: getByTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for elements with visible text matching the provided text or RegExp.

methods.name: getByRoleSelector
methods.description: Constructs a role-based selector string with optional accessibility attributes and states.
